legs.summary: Climb the giant Erdtree root south of West Capital Rampart to reach the Erdtree Sanctuary grace. This requires defeating Godfrey's golden shade — a mandatory boss guarding the inner sanctum. Explore the Fortified Manor for the Volcano Manor co-op invasion (Bernahl) and gather items in the upper city.

steps.text: Find Corhyn and Goldmask near the colosseum north of the capital. To advance the questline: cast Law of Regression (purchased from a cleric) in front of the Radagon statue on the path past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary. The message reveals Radagon and Marika are one. Speak to Goldmask, then Corhyn. This is required to obtain the Mending Rune of Perfect Order (claimed from 99-unsorted — see below) later in the Ashen Capital.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Corhyn and Goldmask must advance their dialogue here in the Royal Capital. If you skip this Law of Regression step, the questline cannot conclude properly in the Ashen Capital for the Perfect Order ending.

steps.text: Visit the Fortified Manor (mirrored copy of Roundtable Hold, in western Leyndell). Bernahl's invasion event can be triggered here — select 'Complete the contract' inside to initiate the co-op phantom invasion (Vargram the Raging Wolf + Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm). Defeat them for the Raging Wolf Armor set and return to Bernahl for Gelmir's Fury.
Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Shade) — mandatory boss at the west side of the Erdtree Sanctuary approach. Climb the large golden root south of West Capital Rampart. Drops a Talisman Pouch.

legs.summary: From the Erdtree Sanctuary, navigate through the Queen's Bedchamber and the colosseum district toward the Elden Throne. Defeat Morgott the Omen King — the final mandatory boss before the Mountaintops. He drops the Rold Medallion needed for the Grand Lift of Rold.

steps.text: From Erdtree Sanctuary, find the exit path through the golden stairway area. The Queen's Bedchamber grace is up the stairs. The Elden Throne is reached via the inner sanctum path — Morgott awaits.

legs.summary: The Subterranean Shunning-Grounds is a sewer dungeon beneath Leyndell, accessed from a well in the city. Drop through the grate near the Underground Roadside grace to navigate the rat-and-Miranda-flower-infested sewers. Dung Eater's cell is here. Mohg the Omen guards the deepest cathedral.

steps.text: From the main Leyndell streets near the east city area, find the open sewer grate and drop down to the Underground Roadside grace. Navigate the sewers south through Miranda Flowers and Fingercreepers to reach the deeper areas.

Navigate to the jail cell in the northeast section of the sewers (past Fingercreepers). Use the Sewer-Gaol Key (from the capital outskirts) to open the cell and release the Dung Eater. He gives you a Seedbed Curse after exhausting his dialogue. He says to come fight him at the outer moat later.

steps.text: Mohg, the Omen — boss in the Cathedral of the Forsaken at the bottom of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Use Mohg's Shackle (found on a corpse near the Forsaken Depths grace) to stagger him in Phase 1. Drops Bloodflame Talons incantation.

legs.summary: CRITICAL DECISION POINT — The Three Fingers are at the very bottom of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, behind an illusory altar at the back of the Cathedral of the Forsaken. Approaching the Three Fingers LOCKS all endings except Lord of Frenzied Flame. The ONLY reversal is Miquella's Needle (obtained after Millicent's questline conclusion at Haligtree) used at the Dragonlord Placidusax arena in Crumbling Farum Azula.

steps.text: MANDATORY DECISION: From the Cathedral of the Forsaken (after Mohg), find the illusory altar at the back and roll through it. Follow the passage down to the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace. Before the door to the Three Fingers is a POINT OF NO RETURN for endings.

WARNING — LORD OF FRENZIED FLAME ENDING LOCK: The door to the Three Fingers room can only be opened if you UNEQUIP ALL ARMOR AND EQUIPMENT (strip naked). Once you step through and receive the Flame of Frenzy from the Three Fingers, the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending is AUTOMATICALLY TRIGGERED when you approach Fractured Marika at the game's end — overriding all other endings (Age of Fracture, Age of Stars, Age of Duskborn, Mending Rune of Perfect Order, Mending Rune of the Fell Curse). The ONLY reversal: obtain Miquella's Needle from Millicent's questline conclusion in the Haligtree, then USE it in the Dragonlord Placidusax boss arena in Crumbling Farum Azula. This removes the Frenzied Flame eye and re-enables other endings.
